source: Unmodified cached OS London five-foot 1893 mosaic
method: Native roof-body axes re-read at the affected Bridge Road junction/frontages. Roof shading, street gaps and corner returns distinguish the bodies from back plots. IDs and height estimates retained; range lengths/centres/angles follow mapped roofs. House counts are estimates from mapped range lengths; one prior long terrace is a single corner body. No road-buffer trimming used.
